# Assets · Favicons

6 files under `assets/Favicons/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for app-icon.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Favicons and app icon

`favicon-16.png` / `favicon-16.svg` — the six-point pyramid (no faint field) for 16px; `favicon-32.png`, `apple-touch-icon-180.png`, `icon-512.png` and `app-icon.svg` — the full lattice on graphite `#0f1215`, points `#ece9e4`, apex `#6ac5e8`. They replace `apps/web/src/app/favicon.ico` and the Next.js defaults in `apps/web/public/`.
